correctness.rationale: Pairwise in-layer squared distances are 4R²sin²(πk/n), cross-layer are h²+4R²sin²(π(k−t)/n). Maximization gives a cross-layer diameter for odd n, and compares 4R² with h²+4R²cos²(πt/n) for even n; the tie is exactly h*=2Rsin(πt/n). Endpoint t=0 and t=1/2 produce exactly forbidden matching nK2, alternating C_{2n}, (n/2) disjoint C4, or antipodally chorded M_{2n}. The last Rips flag complex is simplicially Ind(forbidden graph); joins of S0 and the credited cycle/Möbius independence homotopy theorems yield all claimed spheres/wedges, and r=b fills simplex. Independent geometry for 126 width/twist/height cases checks forbidden-graph degrees; the general real-parameter proof uses exact trigonometric comparisons, not numeric tolerances.
